<a id="clear_play_area"></a>
### [`clear_play_area`](../../../../src/screen/clear_play_area.asm#L6) `$8720`

*routine*

Turns off all sprites and fills the rows 0-21 with spaces in the colour $05. On exit, $03 is 22.
